name: com.uee03.pretzel.preferences
description: Player preferences for audio, graphics, controls and language, saved through Pretzel Data, with change events and graphics apply.

samples.description: Loads preferences at startup, applies graphics and forwards audio volumes to an AudioMixer.
Implements IPreferencesService on PlayerPrefs and in memory, and swaps backends from one composition root.
A runtime UI Toolkit options screen with an Apply/Revert draft and appliers for audio, graphics and language.
